DUMMY THROUGH A CYLINDER, ALLOWS THE FIXING OF A NUDA HANDLE OR ANY OTHER TYPE OF HANDLE ON A DOOR PANEL WITHOUT ANY LOCKING SYSTEM. DUMMY IS A PATENTED PRODUCT DEVELOPED FOR DOORS, BOISERIE PANELS, WALK IN CABINETS WHERE NO LOCKING IS NEEDED BUT JUST PULLING AND PUSHING FUNCTION IS REQUIRED. IT KEEPS THE HANDLE FIXED TO THE PANEL. DUMMY IS SUITABLE FOR FIXING A HANDLE ON BOTH SIDES OR JUST ONE SIDE OF THE DOOR.
DUMMY CLEVER HAS THE SAME FUNCTION OF DUMMY BUT IT CAN ALSO KEEP THE DOOR SHUT THANKS TO MAGNETIC ATTRACTION.
THE PLUS OF THIS PATENTED SYSTEM IS THE MAGNET IN THE CYLINDRICAL BODY WHICH IS ATTRACTED TO ANOTHER MAGNET TO BE FIXED IN THE DOOR FRAME; IN THIS WAY IT IS POSSIBLE TO KEEP THE DOOR SHUT.

Mini mechanism, with a diameter of 29 mm, makes the design even cleaner and more discreet, reducing visual noise and enhancing the harmony of the shapes. It is suitable for all levers in the Nuda collection, available in all finishes, and offered in 4 and 8 movement versions.

Slim mechanism, 24 mm wide, is narrower than a standard mechanism and is ideal for those looking for compact solutions without compromising on aesthetics. It is also compatible with all levers in the Nuda collection, available in all finishes, and comes in 4 and 8 movement versions.

Standard mechanism, with a width of 30 mm, is the recommended choice for replacements. Like the others, it is compatible with all levers in the Nuda collection, available in all finishes, and offered in 4 and 8 movement versions.

Stoppino is an extremely minimalist magnetic floor door stop designed for interior doors. An element for the doors of the house that is a synthesis of that design whose discreet presence is not perceived but whose absence is felt.

Stoppino open is an extremely minimalist magnetic floor door stop designed for interior doors. It's an element for your home's doors, embodying a design whose discreet presence goes unnoticed, but its absence is keenly felt. The door stop prevents doors from slamming shut due to sudden gusts of wind, avoiding impacts with walls or household objects. Installation is quick and easy: the adhesive application is ideal for environments with underfloor heating or where drilling holes is not feasible. The adhesive is tested to withstand conditions with high humidity or temperature.

Stoppino X is the external magnetic door stop that can be applied directly to the door panel, characterized by its ease of installation. This version of Stoppino, in addition to having a treadable base that does not require holes in the floor, is mounted on the door with double-sided adhesive or with simple hidden screws.
A simple and essential object like every Verum Italy idea. Innovation and research to create intelligent solutions for living spaces.

Stoppino Close is a closing system for doors without the use of traditional locks. Thanks to the system with two magnets, it is possible to keep the door in the closed position in any situation. The magnets also allow you to eliminate any noise by moving the door closer or further away. Stoppino Close can be used on wooden doors and aluminum frames.

The choice of material and finish is a fundamental element in the design of every detail. Textures, colors, and reflections not only define the style but also influence the perception and user experience of a product. For this reason, we offer a selection of sophisticated materials and finishes, designed to ensure aesthetics, quality, and durability over time.

Zama is a material with extraordinary characteristics, combining the solidity of a metallic alloy with the versatility of design. Its surface can take on either glossy or satin reflections, enhancing its properties of hardness and durability. To the touch, Zama conveys a sense of solidity, yet also elegance, thanks to its smooth and pleasant surface. Zama is an emblem of reliability, without compromising on high-quality aesthetics, perfectly suited for any project.

Brass is a material rich in history and charm, combining the strength of copper and the ductility of zinc to create an alloy that exudes elegance and warmth. To the touch, brass offers a sensation of solidity and smoothness, with surfaces ranging from polished to satin. It is a material that, despite its robustness, conveys artisanal finesse, telling stories of quality and tradition.

Aluminum is a versatile and lightweight material that combines strength and malleability in a single essence. Despite its reduced weight, aluminum offers excellent corrosion resistance, maintaining its integrity and beauty over time. Aluminum is the perfect choice for those seeking an innovative material that meets the demands of the future with timeless elegance.

Marble is a noble and timeless material, emblematic of elegance and refinement. Its surface, adorned with delicate natural veins and unique shades, tells the story of millennia of geological transformations. Each slab is a one-of-a-kind work of art, capable of capturing light and reflecting an unmistakable luminosity. Perfect for those seeking a material that combines aesthetics and durability, marble is the symbol of eternal beauty, always relevant and capable of evoking emotion.

To actively contribute to the protection of our oceans, we use recycled plastic sourced from Oceanworks®, a global network committed to recovering plastic waste from the ocean. Abandoned fishing nets are transformed into a high-quality material, ideal for the production of our handles. Through this choice, we reduce environmental impact and promote a circular economy. Every piece made with recycled plastic tells a story of recovery, sustainability, and innovation.
